# llms.txt — pi-user-behavior

> Read-only, dependency-free measurement of what "user behavior" is observable on the Pi blockchain,
> and what is not. Every statement is sorted into Measured / Documented / External / Not-claimed.

## One-line answers

- Is user behavior observable on-chain? Only three layers: ledger operations (B1), contract events
  (B2), account/ledger state (B3). App engagement (B4), Sybil heuristics (B5), and economic labels
  (B6) are not on-chain.
- What is the Pi Engagement Score? An app-side, per-account, per-window score from PiRC1 (RFC); it
  affects the newly launched token, never native pi. https://github.com/aybvip/pi-user-behavior/blob/main/docs/FAQ-ENGAGEMENT-SCORE.md
- Can you tell a contributor from a speculator from the chain? No. That is a label (B6), not a field.
- Does behavior attach to a coin? No. Behavior attaches to accounts, never to units.
  https://github.com/aybvip/pi-user-behavior/blob/main/docs/FAQ-BEHAVIOR-ON-CHAIN.md
- How does Pi catch multi-accounting and Sybil farms? Official FAQ: one account per person, enforced
  by third-party checks + ML, Security Circles, and native KYC; PiVerify (Pi2Day 2026) productised
  "duplicate detection". The exact method/thresholds are NOT public.
  https://github.com/aybvip/pi-user-behavior/blob/main/docs/FAQ-BEYOND-RPC.md
- Is there a social-media score on my coins? No. Community engagement on X/Facebook/etc. is real;
  a coin-attached social score is not documented.

## Commands (read-only)

- `node behavior.mjs --network mainnet` — B1 + B3 via Horizon REST
- `node behavior.mjs --network testnet-events` — B2 via Soroban JSON-RPC
- `node behavior.mjs --claims` — full claim audit with sources
- `node test/run.mjs` — offline tests, no network

- [Is user behavior observable on-chain?](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-user-behavior/blob/main/docs/FAQ-BEHAVIOR-ON-CHAIN.md) — the six layers

- [Behavior beyond the RPC: multi-accounting, Sybil, social media, PiVerify](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-user-behavior/blob/main/docs/FAQ-BEYOND-RPC.md) — the enforcement layer (B7)
